# KHM Tutoring

> Expert K-12 tutoring services in Honolulu, Hawaii. Founded 2016. 300+ students helped. 5.0 parent rating.

## About

KHM Tutoring is a premium K-12 tutoring service in Honolulu, Hawaii, founded in 2016 by Kody Kim (Punahou School, UC Irvine). The company provides personalized one-on-one tutoring with 10+ expert educators, including graduates from Harvard University (Magna Cum Laude), Princeton University, Phillips Exeter Academy, and Penn State. Tutors include a Fulbright Scholar, a medical student with a top-0.5% MCAT score (525/528), and a 35-year Iolani School teaching veteran.

## Free Diagnostic Test

KHM Tutoring offers a free, no-login academic diagnostic test at https://www.khmtutoring.com/diagnostic-test. The test takes 15-70 minutes and covers grade-appropriate topics for Elementary (K-5), Middle School (6-8), or High School (9-12) in Math or English. After completing the test, parents receive a personalized topic-by-topic breakdown by email along with an invitation for a free tutoring consultation. Results are confidential and the test is available to all families regardless of whether they become customers.

## Group SAT Prep Program

KHM Tutoring offers a small-cohort SAT prep program at https://www.khmtutoring.com/group-sat-prep. Cohorts of 6-8 students are organized by level, readiness, and schedule. The program is 20 hours of live instruction covering SAT content, timing, strategy, and pattern recognition. Three schedule windows are available: Sunday mornings, weekday after-school, and weekday evenings. Sessions begin September 21, 2026. Students submit a fit form to be placed in the right cohort.
